C0386.title: Yueqing Employee Convicted for Absconding with Company Funds
C0386.summary: In late August 2025, the head of a Wenzhou trading company sought help from the Yueqing Legal Service Center for Enterprises, saying an employee had used their position to misappropriate company funds and then disappeared, causing losses in overseas business. After the Yueqing People Procuratorate intervened to guide investigation and evidence collection, the employee was arrested, and prosecutors coordinated case handling around the company cross-border business losses.

references.title: Procuratorate Daily: Yueqing Prosecutors Handle Overseas Employee Embezzlement Case
